title: bheka.tenant.provisioned.v1
description: Emitted by bheka-gateway when a new tenant is successfully created and its initial key custody configuration is set. Consumed by bheka-notify (welcome sequence) and the billing pipeline (010_EVENT_BUS_AND_TOPICS section 2).

event_id.description: UUIDv7. De-duplicate consumers on this field.

tenant_id.description: UUIDv7 of the newly created tenant.

key_custody_tier.description: Which of the three custody tiers (CANON section 6) was configured.

provisioned_by.description: UUIDv7 of the eride_support_engineer user who created this tenant.
